method: Reviewed issue-time admission of the committed environmental refresh and the most recent coherent owner-camera generation against the 00:14 CT snapshot. Camera evidence older than 60 minutes and the failed E3 view were classified UNKNOWN. Fresh KBFM and lower-river observations were admitted only as zero-weight regional/upstream context; KMOB maintenance-flagged fields, rainfall and direct local oxygen/stratification remained UNKNOWN. With no new direct event evidence, the prior heuristic ranges and zero production weights were retained.
missing_inputs: All six owner-camera views are UNKNOWN at issue time: five successful 00:06 CT captures are 67.646-70.379 minutes old and pcl_e3_bay_mouth failed that cycle; missing or stale views are not negative evidence.
KMOB fields are QC-rejected because the selected report carries a station-maintenance flag; KBFM is fresh regional context only and rainfall fields remain UNKNOWN.
Weeks Bay water-quality/oxygen station WKQA1 remains stale; fresh WKXA1 meteorology is regional context only.
Direct local bottom/contact-strip oxygen, salinity/temperature profiles and stratification remain UNKNOWN.
Observed local water level/currents and shoreline wind/rain remain UNKNOWN; model guidance and regional proxies are not local observations.
Out-of-view biology and full-cell non-events remain UNKNOWN; no new public-player or human-report search is claimed.
Missing model slices and stale, missing or QC-rejected observations remain UNKNOWN; see per-source admission.
